description: This file defines strategies for creating, updating, and validating FlowSchema objects in Kubernetes API server, including handling of status updates and reset fields.

classes.name: flowSchemaStrategy
classes.description: Implements verification logic for FlowSchema objects, including create, update, validation, and reset fields.

classes.name: flowSchemaStatusStrategy
classes.description: Handles status-specific update logic for FlowSchema objects.

methods.name: NamespaceScoped
methods.description: Returns false indicating FlowSchema is a cluster-scoped resource.

methods.name: GetResetFields
methods.description: Returns fields that are reset and should not be modified by users, based on API version.

methods.name: PrepareForCreate
methods.description: Initializes a new FlowSchema object before creation, resetting status and setting generation.

methods.name: PrepareForUpdate
methods.description: Prepares a FlowSchema object for update, handling generation bump if spec changes.

methods.name: WarningsOnCreate
methods.description: Returns warnings during creation, currently none.

methods.name: Canonicalize
methods.description: Normalizes the object after validation, no implementation here.

methods.name: ValidateUpdate
methods.description: Validates updates to a FlowSchema object.

methods.name: WarningsOnUpdate
methods.description: Returns warnings during update, currently none.

methods.name: GetResetFields (StatusStrategy)
methods.description: Returns reset fields for status updates, including metadata and spec.

methods.name: PrepareForUpdate (StatusStrategy)
methods.description: Prepares a FlowSchema object for status update, preserving managed fields and object meta.

methods.name: ValidateUpdate (StatusStrategy)
methods.description: Validates status update of a FlowSchema.
